description: This file defines an immutable Java class 'HealthCheckingActorOptions' which encapsulates configuration options for health checking in the system. It includes properties such as whether health check is enabled, the check interval, and persistence check enablement, along with a builder class for constructing instances.

classes.name: HealthCheckingActorOptions
classes.description: Immutable class representing health check configuration options, including enablement flags and interval.

classes.name: HealthCheckingActorOptions.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for creating instances of HealthCheckingActorOptions with optional persistence check enablement.

methods.name: getBuilder
methods.description: Static method to obtain a Builder instance with given global enablement flag and interval.

methods.name: isHealthCheckEnabled
methods.description: Returns true if health check is globally enabled.

methods.name: getInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval duration for health checks.

methods.name: isPersistenceCheckEnabled
methods.description: Indicates if persistence health check is enabled.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare configuration instances.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the configuration instance.

methods.name: Builder constructor
methods.description: Constructs a Builder with initial enablement flag and interval.

methods.name: enablePersistenceCheck
methods.description: Enables persistence check in the configuration.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds and returns a HealthCheckingActorOptions instance from the builder.
